text:
tara: throwing a quick idea on the table: we should add execution "guardrails" for mixed-bit/sparse paths so we can (a) avoid silent quality hits, (b) do per-customer chargeback if they opt into aggressive fallbacks. thoughts?

leo: love it. is this just runtime checks or also packaging-level signals?

tara: both. model bundle carries a precision profile + small calibration table. runtime uses that to predict quality delta for a fallback and decides based on policy.

jen: what policy surfaces? per-deployment flags? per-customer? global controls?

omar: propose three knobs: allow_fallback (bool), max_quality_drop_pct (float), billing_tier_on_fallback (enum). default: allow_fallback=false.

pav: billing tie-in needs careful UX: we shouldn't surprise customers. require explicit opt-in during deploy and surface estimated cost savings vs predicted quality drop. SDK should show a preview.

leo: runtime flow sketch: 1) parse profile; 2) on kernel miss consult fallback_order; 3) for each candidate compute estimated_delta from calibration table; 4) if delta <= max_quality_drop_pct and allow_fallback true -> apply; else route to compatible dense variant or fail. emit quant.path + quant.quality_decision telemetry.

tara: add hysteresis: count repeated fallbacks per session and throttle after N to avoid tail degradation. also add deterministic sampling of inputs that hit fallback (sample_seed derived from customer_id) for replay.

omar: metrics to alert on: fallback_rate_by_customer, avg_quality_delta_by_customer, fallback_cost_savings_estimate. and an SRE alert when a single customer exceeds quality budget frequently.

jen: operations question: can we do staged rollouts where only nodes in a canary pool advertise mixed-bit kernels and routing only sends opt-in customers?

pav: yes, route by precision_profile header or deployment tag. we already do similar for GPU variants. need a linter that blocks a deployment advertising profile without a fallback policy.

leo: quick sample profile (json string in bundle): {"profile_version":"v1","per_shard":["fp8","int8"],"fallback_order":["int8","fp16"],"calibration":{"int8":0.6,"fp16":0.1},"quality_budget_pct":0.5}

chi-bot: Canary created: mixedbit-guardrails-canary. status: awaiting-smoke-run.

tara: ok action items: jen drafts runtime guardrail code + telemetry keys; pav adds billing-preview to deploy flow; leo adds deterministic sampling hook; omar wires alerts. aim: small canary next week.

jen: will do, i'll post a short RFC addendum.
